title: A Multi-Invariant Preserving Discrete Gradient Methods
summary: This work introduces a novel structure-preserving methods for conservative systems based on a predictor-corrector strategy. The framework applies a discrete gradient correction to predictions generated by explicit one-step or multi-step schemes, which preserves nonlinear invariants while maintaining the accuracy order of the original predictor. This approach extends naturally to problems requiring simultaneous conservation of multiple invariants.
